brief.title: Samsung Galaxy Ecosystem 2025: Innovation Across Every Category
brief.one_liner: Discover Samsung's complete 2025 Galaxy lineup spanning smartphones, foldables, wearables, audio, and smart home — all powered by AI.
brief.goal: Viewers should understand the breadth and depth of Samsung's 2025 product ecosystem, recognize the newest flagship launches, and feel compelled to explore or purchase Galaxy products.

sections.title: New for 2025: Flagship Launches
sections.objective: Highlight the newest products — Galaxy S26 Ultra and Galaxy Buds4 Pro — as the marquee launches driving the 2025 lineup.

sections.title: The Complete Galaxy Ecosystem
sections.objective: Showcase the full range of product categories (smartphones, foldables, tablets, wearables, audio, TVs, home appliances) to convey ecosystem scale.

sections.title: AI-Powered Everything
sections.objective: Emphasize Samsung's Bespoke AI branding across home appliances and Galaxy AI across mobile devices as a unifying innovation theme.

sections.title: Category Highlights at a Glance
sections.objective: Provide a quick-reference table of key products per category so viewers can scan the full portfolio in seconds.
